senses.gloss: c. (צְמַת) (forced) meeting of tradesmen for public labors, taxation &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:45">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite> <he>חנותא … הוה לון צ׳</he> the storekeepers of … had a meeting (v. <cite ref="K00430"><he>כותנאי</he></cite>). Ib. 15ᶜ bot. <he>אתת צַמּוּת לטחונייא</he> a summons for public work was issued to the millers; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:10">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אתא מצוותא</he> (read <he>צוּמּוּתָא</he>); a. e.
